question: 有多少板球运动员具备左臂快速投球技术？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.Player_Id) FROM soccer_2016.Player AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Bowling_Style AS T2 ON T1.Bowling_skill = T2.Bowling_Id WHERE T2.Bowling_skill = 'Left-arm fast'

question: 板球比赛编号392195的结果类型是什么？
query: SELECT T2.Outcome_Type FROM soccer_2016.Match AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Outcome AS T2 ON T1.Outcome_type = T2.Outcome_Id WHERE T1.Match_Id = '392195'

question: 最年轻的板球运动员来自哪个城市？
query: SELECT T3.City_Name FROM soccer_2016.Player AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Country AS T2 ON T1.Country_Name = T2.Country_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.City AS T3 ON T2.Country_Id = T3.Country_Id ORDER BY T1.DOB DESC LIMIT 1

question: Pune Warriors 参加了几个板球赛季？
query: SELECT COUNT(T.Season_Year) FROM ( SELECT T4.Season_Year FROM soccer_2016.Team AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.match_winner INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T3 ON T1.Team_Id = T3.Team_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Season AS T4 ON T2.Season_Id = T4.Season_Id WHERE T1.Team_Name = 'Pune Warriors' GROUP BY T4.Season_Year ) T

question: R Dravid 的出生年份是什么？他担任过哪些角色？
query: SELECT T1.DOB, T3.Role_Desc FROM soccer_2016.Player AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T2 ON T1.Player_Id = T2.Player_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Rolee AS T3 ON T2.Role_Id = T3.Role_Id WHERE T1.Player_Name = 'R Dravid' GROUP BY T1.DOB, T3.Role_Desc

question: SC Ganguly 获得过多少次板球单场最佳球员？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.Man_of_the_Match) FROM soccer_2016.Player AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.Player_Id = T2.Man_of_the_Match INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T3 ON T3.Player_Id = T1.Player_Id WHERE T1.Player_Name = 'SC Ganguly'

question: Mumbai Indians 在2008年赢了多少场板球比赛？
query: SELECT COUNT(T.Match_Id) FROM ( SELECT T2.Match_Id FROM soccer_2016.Team AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.match_winner INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T3 ON T1.Team_Id = T3.Team_Id WHERE T1.Team_Name = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T2.Match_Date LIKE '2008%' GROUP BY T2.Match_Id ) T

question: 板球比赛编号335993中哪支球队以击球手出局数获胜？
query: SELECT T1.Team_Name FROM soccer_2016.Team AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.match_winner INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T3 ON T1.Team_Id = T3.Team_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Win_By AS T4 ON T2.Win_Type = T4.Win_Id WHERE T2.Match_Id = '335993' GROUP BY T1.Team_Name

question: 统计所有板球赛季中以击球手出局数获胜的比赛数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.Match_Id) FROM soccer_2016.Match AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Win_By AS T2 ON T1.Win_Type = T2.Win_Id WHERE T2.Win_type = 'wickets'

question: 1975年至1985年出生的印度板球运动员占所有运动员的比例是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Country_Name = 'India' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Player_Id) FROM soccer_2016.Player AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Country AS T2 ON T1.Country_Name = T2.Country_ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.DOB) BETWEEN '1975' AND '1985'

question: 计算左手击球板球运动员占所有运动员的百分比。
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Batting_hand = 'Left-hand bat' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Player_Id) FROM soccer_2016.Player AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Batting_Style AS T2 ON T1.Batting_hand = T2.Batting_Id

question: 以得分获胜的板球比赛占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.win_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Win_Type) FROM soccer_2016.Match AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Win_By AS T2 ON T1.Win_Type = T2.Win_Id

question: 有多少场板球比赛的获胜分差为7分？
query: SELECT COUNT(Match_Id) FROM soccer_2016.Match WHERE win_margin = 7

question: 1970年到1975年出生的板球运动员总数是多少？
query: SELECT COUNT(Player_Id) FROM soccer_2016.Player WHERE strftime('%Y', DOB) BETWEEN '1970' AND '1975'

question: 2009年4月26日获胜分差为6分的板球比赛赢家是哪支球队？
query: SELECT T1.Team_Name FROM soccer_2016.Team AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.match_winner WHERE T2.Win_Margin = 6 AND T2.Match_Date = '2009-04-26'

question: 板球比赛编号419135中哪支球队以得分获胜？
query: SELECT T1.Team_Name FROM soccer_2016.Team AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.match_winner INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Win_By AS T3 ON T2.win_type = T3.win_id WHERE T2.Match_Id = 419135

question: 有多少板球运动员来自斯里兰卡？
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM soccer_2016.Player AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Country AS T2 ON T1.Country_Name = T2.Country_ID WHERE T2.Country_Name = 'Sri Lanka'

question: 列出担任过队长的板球运动员姓名。
query: SELECT T2.Player_Name FROM soccer_2016.Player_Match AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Player AS T2 ON T1.Player_Id = T2.Player_Id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Rolee AS T3 ON T1.Role_Id = T3.Role_Id WHERE T3.Role_Desc = 'Captain' GROUP BY T2.Player_Name

question: 给出板球比赛编号392194的场馆和获胜球队。
query: SELECT T1.Venue_Name, T3.Team_Name FROM soccer_2016.Venue AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.venue_id = T2.venue_id INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Team AS T3 ON T2.match_winner = T3.Team_Id WHERE T2.Match_Id = 392194

question: 2009年 Delhi Daredevils 板球队以击球手出局数获胜的比赛占其获胜场次的百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.Win_Type = 'wickets' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T3.Win_Type) FROM soccer_2016.Team AS T1 INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Match AS T2 ON T1.Team_Id = T2.Match_Winner INNER JOIN soccer_2016.Win_By AS T3 ON T2.Win_Type = T3.Win_Id WHERE T1.Team_Name = 'Delhi Daredevils' AND T2.Match_Date LIKE '2009%'

question: 对于位于细胞质膜的基因，请列出它们的染色体编号。
query: SELECT T1.Chromosome FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Classification AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID WHERE T2.Localization = 'plasma membrane'

question: 位于细胞核中的非必需基因有多少个？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.GeneID) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Classification AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID WHERE T2.Localization = 'nucleus' AND T1.Essential = 'Non-Essential'

question: 在有核酸代谢缺陷的基因中，有多少个位于液泡中？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.GeneID) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Classification AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID WHERE T2.Localization = 'vacuole' AND T1.Phenotype = 'Nucleic acid metabolism defects'

question: 染色体数量最多的基因位于什么位置？
query: SELECT T2.Localization FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Classification AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID ORDER BY T1.Chromosome DESC LIMIT 1

question: 表达相关性得分最低的基因对其功能是什么？
query: SELECT T1.Function FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 ORDER BY T2.Expression_Corr ASC LIMIT 1

question: 在属于马达蛋白类的基因对中，有多少对是负相关的？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.GeneID) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T2.Expression_Corr < 0 AND T1.Class = 'Motorproteins'

question: 对于一条有8条染色体、另一条有6条染色体的基因对，最高的表达相关性得分是多少？
query: SELECT T2.Expression_Corr FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T1.Chromosome = 6 OR T1.Chromosome = 8 ORDER BY T2.Expression_Corr DESC LIMIT 1

question: 请列出位于细胞质且具有7条染色体的基因的基序。
query: SELECT T2.GeneID1, T2.GeneID2 FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T1.Localization = 'cytoplasm' AND T1.Chromosome = 7

question: 在功能为转录的非必需基因中，有多少个不位于细胞质？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.GeneID) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T1.Localization != 'cytoplasm' AND T1.Function = 'TRANSCRIPTION' AND T1.Essential = 'NON-Essential'

question: 正相关的基因对中有多少对双方都是非必需的？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.GeneID2) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T2.Expression_Corr > 0 AND T1.Essential = 'Non-Essential'

question: 如果一对基因正相关，那么双方染色体数都超过10条的概率是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Chromosome > 10 AND T3.Chromosome > 10, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.GeneID) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 INNER JOIN genes.Genes AS T3 ON T3.GeneID = T2.GeneID2 WHERE T2.Expression_Corr > 0

question: 双方都属于ATP酶类的基因对，其平均表达相关性得分是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(T2.Expression_Corr) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T1.Class = 'ATPases'

question: 列出位于细胞质且功能为代谢的所有基因标识号。
query: SELECT DISTINCT GeneID FROM genes.Genes WHERE Localization = 'cytoplasm' AND Function = 'METABOLISM'

question: 位于细胞质膜和细胞核的基因加起来有多少种不同的基因？
query: SELECT COUNT(GeneID) FROM genes.Classification WHERE Localization IN ('plasma', 'nucleus')

question: 物理类型相互作用的基因对中表达相关性是怎样的？其中负相关的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT Expression_Corr FROM genes.Interactions WHERE Type = 'Physical' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(SUM(Expression_Corr < 0) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM genes.Interactions WHERE Type = 'Physical'

question: 位于细胞骨架的基因中未知类别占百分之多少？其中有多少不是条件表型？
query: SELECT SUM(Localization = 'cytoskeleton' AND Phenotype = 'Conditional phenotypes') , CAST(SUM(Localization = 'cytoskeleton') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(GeneID) FROM genes.Genes;

question: 功能为转录且被归类为非必需的基因中发生什么类型的相互作用？
query: SELECT T2.Type FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T1.Function = 'TRANSCRIPTION' AND T1.Essential = 'Non-Essential'

question: 列出与位于细胞核的基因发生正相关相互作用的所有基因。
query: SELECT T1.GeneID FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T2.Expression_Corr > 0 AND T1.Localization = 'nucleus'

question: 以位于细胞核的转录因子类必需基因为参考，有多少个与另一基因发生遗传型相互作用？列出它们。
query: SELECT T2.GeneID1 FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T1.Localization = 'nucleus' AND T1.Class = 'Transcription factors' AND T1.Essential = 'Essential' AND T2.Expression_Corr != 0

question: 在表型为细胞周期缺陷的非必需非马达蛋白类基因中，有多少个不发生物理型相互作用？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.GeneID) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T2.Type != 'Physical' AND T1.Phenotype = 'Cell cycle defects' AND T1.Class != 'Motorproteins' AND T1.Essential = 'Non-Essential'

question: 在表型为核酸代谢缺陷且基序为PS00107的基因中，与另一基因发生正相互作用的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Expression_Corr > 0, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.GeneID1) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T1.Phenotype = 'Nucleic acid metabolism defects' AND T1.Motif = 'PS00107'

question: 负相关的遗传相互作用基因中哪些是非必需的？它们相对于必需基因的百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.GeneID) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(T1.GeneID) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T2.Expression_Corr < 0 ) FROM genes.Genes AS T1 INNER JOIN genes.Interactions AS T2 ON T1.GeneID = T2.GeneID1 WHERE T2.Expression_Corr < 0 AND T1.Essential = 'Non-Essential'

question: 职业篮球队的主场获胜占其总获胜场次的百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(homeWon AS REAL) * 100 / won  FROM professional_basketball.teams

question: 哪些职业篮球队输掉的比赛超过总比赛场次的75%？
query: SELECT name FROM professional_basketball.teams WHERE CAST(lost AS REAL) * 100 / games > 75

question: 列出2005年获胜场次比上一年更多的职业篮球队名称及其总胜场数。
query: SELECT T1.name, T1.won FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM professional_basketball.teams WHERE year = 2004 ) AS T2 on T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.year = 2005 and T1.won > T2.won

question: 对于主场胜场比主场负场多出80%以上的职业篮球队，列出球队名称和进攻得分。
query: SELECT name, o_pts FROM professional_basketball.teams WHERE CAST((homeWon - homeLost) AS REAL) * 100 / games > 80

question: 参加了季后赛的职业篮球队中排名第一的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(name) FROM professional_basketball.teams

question: 1950年执教 BOS 队的教练是谁？列出教练ID及其胜场和负场数。
query: SELECT coachID, won, lost FROM professional_basketball.coaches WHERE year = 1950 AND tmID = 'BOS'

question: 2000年胜场超过50场的教练有哪些？列出教练ID、球队名称和主场胜场数。
query: SELECT T1.coachID, T2.name, T2.won FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2000 AND T2.won > 50

question: 列出2000年至2010年间负场多于胜场的所有教练。列出教练ID、球队名称和年份。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID, T2.tmID, T1.year FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 AND T2.lost > T2.won

question: adelmri01 在1990年至1995年间执教过哪些职业篮球队？列出球队名称、年份和进攻得分。
query: SELECT T2.name, T1.year, T2.o_pts FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 1995 AND T1.coachID = 'adelmri01'

question: 哪些职业篮球队胜率达到90%？列出球队的教练ID和参赛年份。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name, T1.year, T1.coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE CAST(T2.won AS REAL) * 100 / T2.games > 90

question: 1980年至2000年间获得最佳防守一阵的NBA球员中有多少来自纽约州？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthState = 'NY' AND T2.award = 'All-Defensive First Team' AND T2.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2000

question: 1977年NBA年度最佳教练奖得主在1976年执教的球队属于哪个赛区？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.divID FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.year = 1977 AND T1.award = 'NBA Coach of the Year' AND T3.year = 1976

question: 1981年执教芝加哥公牛队的教练中，谁在1970年代获得过NBA年度最佳教练奖？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T1.tmID WHERE T2.award = 'NBA Coach of the Year' AND T2.year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1979 AND T1.year = 1981 AND T3.name = 'Chicago Bulls'

question: 2006赛季效力于西部联盟且总盖帽数为2的NBA球员昵称是什么？
query: SELECT T2.nameNick FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.blocks = 2 AND T1.conference = 'West' AND T1.season_id = 2006

question: 在季后赛最后一轮击败休斯顿的球队中，哪一年该队排名最低？
query: SELECT T2.year FROM professional_basketball.series_post AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmIDWinner = T2.tmID WHERE T1.round = 'DSF' AND T1.tmIDLoser = 'HSM' ORDER BY T2.rank ASC LIMIT 1

question: 1985年全明星赛季助攻最多的球员出生日期是什么？
query: SELECT T1.birthDate FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.season_id = 1985 ORDER BY T2.assists DESC LIMIT 1

question: 出生在 Winter Haven 且在1980年代全明星赛中每赛季上场12分钟的球员是谁？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthCity = 'Winter Haven' AND T2.season_id BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 AND T2.minutes = 12

question: 在东部联盟上场不超过5分钟的全明星球员中，有多少人上过伊利诺伊大学？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.conference = 'East' AND T2.minutes <= 5 AND T1.college = 'Illinois'

question: 1990年至2007年间，全明星球员中防守篮板占总篮板75%以上的有多少人？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT playerID) FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar WHERE CAST(d_rebounds AS REAL) * 100 / rebounds > 75 AND season_id BETWEEN 1990 AND 2007

question: 教练 costela01 在哪一年获得了执教生涯最佳胜率？
query: SELECT year FROM professional_basketball.coaches WHERE coachID = 'costela01' ORDER BY CAST(won AS REAL) / (won + lost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 来自布鲁克林、绰号超人的NBA球员在所有全明星赛季总共上场了多少分钟？
query: SELECT SUM(T2.minutes) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthCity = 'Brooklyn' AND T1.nameNick LIKE '%Superman%'

question: 1994年NBA年度最佳教练奖得主执教过的所有球队中，哪支球队主场输球最多？
query: SELECT T3.tmID FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.year = 1994 AND T1.award = 'NBA Coach of the Year' GROUP BY T3.tmID ORDER BY SUM(T3.homeLost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1996年NBA季后赛决赛轮击败LAL的球队中，哪支在常规赛赢球超过60场？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.series_post AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmIDWinner = T2.tmID WHERE T2.won > 60 AND T1.year = 1996 AND T1.round = 'CSF' AND T1.tmIDLoser = 'LAL'

question: 体重比最重球员轻40%且身高80英寸的球员在哪个联赛打球？
query: SELECT T2.lgID FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T2.lgID, T1.weight HAVING T1.weight = MAX(T1.weight) - MAX(T1.weight) * 0.4

question: 哪位教练执教期间球队季后赛胜场最多？
query: SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches ORDER BY post_wins DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在执教过超过2支NBA球队的教练中，谁执教期间球队季后赛负场最少？
query: SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches WHERE lgID = 'NBA' AND post_wins != 0 AND post_losses != 0 AND coachID IN ( SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches WHERE lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY coachID HAVING COUNT(tmID) > 2 ) ORDER BY post_losses ASC LIMIT 1

question: ABA联赛的球员中有多少是中锋位置？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID = 'ABA' AND (T1.pos = 'C' OR T1.pos = 'F-C')

question: 请列出NBA联赛中前锋位置球员的名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE (T1.pos = 'F' OR T1.pos = 'F-C') AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 在芝加哥上高中的NBA球员中有多少人属于西部联盟？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.hsCity = 'Chicago' AND T2.conference = 'West'

question: 请列出东部联盟球员就读的大学名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.college FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.conference = 'East'

question: NBL联赛中有多少球员出生在Spencer？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthCity = 'Spencer' AND T2.lgID = 'NBL'

question: 获得MVP次数最多的NBA球员出生日期是什么？
query: SELECT T1.birthDate FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Most Valuable Player' GROUP BY T1.playerID, T1.birthDate ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 出生在Whitestone的NBA球员中有多少人获得过MVP？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND T1.birthCity = 'Whitestone'

question: 获得年度最佳新秀奖的NBA球员中，身高最高的是多少？
query: SELECT T1.height FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Rookie of the Year' ORDER BY T1.height DESC LIMIT 1

question: 获得年度最佳新秀奖的NBA球员平均体重是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(T1.weight) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Rookie of the Year'

question: 在纽约出生且获得过MVP的NBA球员平均身高是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(T1.height) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND T1.birthCity = 'New York'

question: 请列出2000年季后赛得分最高的前十支NBA球队。
query: SELECT tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams WHERE year = 2000 GROUP BY tmID ORDER BY SUM(PostPoints) DESC LIMIT 10

question: 哪些NBA球队胜率低于50%？
query: SELECT name FROM professional_basketball.teams WHERE lgID = 'NBA' AND CAST(won AS REAL) * 100 / (won + lost) < 50

question: 胜率达到80%以上的NBA球队教练是谁？
query: SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches WHERE lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY tmID, coachID HAVING CAST(won AS REAL) * 100 / (won + lost) > 80

question: 哪位教练在NBA执教超过10年？
query: SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches WHERE lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY coachID HAVING MAX(year) - MIN(year) > 10

question: NBA中有多少支球队总得分超过3800分且有球员获得过最有价值球员奖？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T4.name) FROM ( SELECT T1.name, SUM(T2.points) FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T3 ON T2.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T3.award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND T1.lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY T1.name HAVING SUM(T2.points) >= 3800 ) AS T4

question: AFS队中身高最高的NBA球员是谁？列出他的全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'AFS' ORDER BY T1.height DESC LIMIT 1

question: 请列出BLB队所有NBA球员的姓。
query: SELECT T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'BLB' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1962年至1975年间有多少位教练获得过奖项？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT coachID) FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches WHERE year BETWEEN 1962 AND 1975

question: 请列出1970年至1990年间获得过两次奖项的教练ID。
query: SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches WHERE year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1990 GROUP BY coachID, award HAVING COUNT(award) = 2

question: 1962年至2011年间，有多少位教练既获得过NBA奖项又获得过ABA奖项？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT coachID) FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches WHERE year BETWEEN 1962 AND 2011 AND award = 'ABA Coach of the Year' AND coachID IN ( SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches WHERE year BETWEEN 1962 AND 2011 AND award = 'NBA Coach of the Year' )

question: 1975年全明星赛球员的平均得分是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(T2.points) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.season_id = 1975

question: 请列出全明星赛中身高超过75英寸的球员的姓和名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lastName, T1.firstName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.height > 75

question: 来自UCLA大学的全明星球员中最低体重是多少？
query: SELECT MIN(T1.weight) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.college = 'UCLA'

question: 美国全明星球员中最高体重是多少？
query: SELECT MAX(T1.weight) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthCountry = 'USA'

question: 1960年至1970年间，仍健在的全明星球员总得分是多少？
query: SELECT SUM(T2.points) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.season_id BETWEEN 1960 AND 1970 AND T1.deathDate = '0000-00-00'

question: 1950年后出生且进攻篮板率超过30%的球员有哪些？请列出他们的姓和名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lastName, T1.firstName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthDate > 1950 AND CAST(T2.o_rebounds AS REAL) * 100 / T2.rebounds > 30

question: 1969年至2010年间有多少球员获得过年度最佳新秀奖？
query: SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM professional_basketball.awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 1969 AND 2010 AND award = 'Rookie of the Year'

question: 请列出拥有至少3名全明星球员的球队名称。
query: SELECT T1.tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.tmID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) >= 3

question: 1950年至1970年间排名第一的球队中球员的最高得分是多少？
query: SELECT MAX(T2.points) FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1970 AND T1.rank = 1

question: 请列出1937年至1940年连续三年排名第一的球队中全明星球员的姓和名。
query: SELECT T5.lastName, T5.firstName FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T4 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T5 ON T4.playerID = T5.playerID WHERE T4.year BETWEEN 1937 AND 1940 AND T4.tmID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T1.tmID FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID AND T3.year - T2.year = 1 AND T2.year - T1.year = 1 WHERE T1.rank = 1 AND T1.year BETWEEN 1937 AND 1940 )

question: 1937年至1940年排名第三的球队中球员得分最高的是哪支球队？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.rank = 3 AND T1.year BETWEEN 1937 AND 1940 ORDER BY T2.points DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1937年有多少支球队的球员总得分至少500分？
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT T2.name, SUM(T1.points) FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 1937 GROUP BY T2.name HAVING SUM(points) >= 500 ) AS T3

question: 1990年胜率超过75%的NBA球队中有多少名球员？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE CAST(T2.won AS REAL) * 100 / CAST(T2.games AS REAL) > 75 AND T1.year = 1990 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 请列出NBA中最矮的三名黑人球员姓名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.race = 'B' AND T1.height > 0 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T1.height ASC LIMIT 3

question: 1970年选秀中有多少名叫Joe的球员被选中？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT playerID) FROM professional_basketball.draft WHERE firstName = 'Joe' AND draftYear = 1970

question: George Mikan在1951年至1953年间一共投中了多少球？
query: SELECT SUM(fg_made) FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar WHERE first_name = 'George' AND last_name = 'Mikan' AND season_id BETWEEN 1951 AND 1953

question: NBA球员的BMI指数范围是多少？
query: SELECT MIN(CAST(weight AS REAL) / (height * height)), MAX(CAST(weight AS REAL) / (height * height)) FROM professional_basketball.players

question: 主场胜率最高的NBA球队叫什么名字？
query: SELECT name FROM professional_basketball.teams WHERE lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY CAST(homeWon AS REAL) / (homeWon + homeLost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Alexis Ajinca第一次被选中时多大年龄？
query: SELECT draftYear - strftime('%Y', birthDate) FROM professional_basketball.draft AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.firstName = 'Alexis' AND T1.lastName = 'Ajinca' AND draftRound = 1

question: 1980年以来丹佛掘金队最高的球员是谁？列出姓名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T3.name = 'Denver Nuggets' AND T2.year > 1980 ORDER BY T1.height DESC LIMIT 1

question: 已故的NBA球员中获得奖项最多的是谁？
query: SELECT T1.playerID FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE deathDate IS NOT NULL AND deathDate != '0000-00-00' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 拥有最多UCLA毕业球员的NBA球队叫什么名字？
query: SELECT T3.name FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.college = 'UCLA' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY T3.name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1972年到1973年ABA联赛中胜率增长最快的球队叫什么名字？
query: SELECT T1.name FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM professional_basketball.teams WHERE lgID = 'ABA' AND year = 1972 ) AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.lgID = 'ABA' AND T1.year = 1973 ORDER BY (CAST(T1.won AS REAL) / (T1.won + T1.lost) - (CAST(T2.won AS REAL) / (T2.won + T2.lost))) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 请列出NBL联赛中个人犯规最多的球员的名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID = 'NBL' GROUP BY T1.playerID, T1.firstName ORDER BY SUM(T2.PF) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 东部联盟全明星球员的平均身高是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(DISTINCT height) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE conference = 'East'

question: 获得ABA年度最佳教练奖的教练中谁的胜场数最高？
query: SELECT T1.coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.award = 'ABA Coach of the Year' GROUP BY T1.coachID ORDER BY SUM(T1.won) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 选中Mike Lynn的NBA球队叫什么名字？
query: SELECT T1.name FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.draft AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.draftYear WHERE T2.firstName = 'Mike' AND T2.lastName = 'Lynn'

question: 1985年至1990年获得进步最快球员奖的球员中有多少来自美国？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.awards_players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.award = 'Most Improved Player' AND T2.birthCountry = 'USA' AND T1.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 1990

question: 请列出读过加州大学且入选全明星的NBA球员姓名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T3 ON T1.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T1.college = 'California' AND T3.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1950年至1970年间有多少位教练获得过1次以上奖项？
query: SELECT COUNT(coachID) FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1970 GROUP BY coachID HAVING COUNT(coachID) > 1

question: 1969年至1975年间有多少球员获得过最有价值球员奖？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT playerID) FROM professional_basketball.awards_players WHERE year BETWEEN 1969 AND 1975 AND award = 'Most Valuable Player'

question: 请列出至少有5名球员出生在同一个州的NBA球队名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM professional_basketball.teams WHERE tmID IN ( SELECT tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.birthState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.tmID, T2.birthState HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 )

question: NBA中有多少支球队拥有至少3名全明星球员？
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY T1.tmID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) > 3 ) AS T3

question: 1937年排名第6的NBA球队中有多少名球员？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T3.year = 1937 AND T3.rank = 6 AND T3.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1950年负率低于20%的NBA球队中有多少名球员？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE CAST(T3.lost AS REAL) * 100 / (T3.lost + T3.won) < 20 AND T3.year = 1950 AND T3.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 列出出生在美国以外国家的NBA球员全名。
query: SELECT firstName, middleName, lastName FROM professional_basketball.players WHERE birthCountry != 'USA'

question: 列出所有执教过超过2支不同球队的教练ID。
query: SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches GROUP BY coachID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tmID) > 2

question: 1988年哪位教练的胜场减去负场的差值最大？
query: SELECT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches WHERE year = 1988 AND lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY won - lost DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2010年获得NBA年度最佳教练奖的教练执教的是哪支球队？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.tmID FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 2010 AND T2.award = 'NBA Coach of the Year'

question: 列出罚球命中率100%的NBA全明星球员的姓名、身高和体重。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T1.height, T1.weight FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.ft_attempted > 0 AND ft_attempted = ft_made

question: 列出1965年至1970年间从西雅图选中的NBA球员姓名及选中他们的球队名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.draft AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T2.draftFrom = 'Seattle' AND T2.draftYear BETWEEN 1965 AND 1970 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 列出2003年获得总决赛MVP的NBA球员全名及当时年龄。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName , 2003 - strftime('%Y', T1.birthDate) FROM professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T1 ON T2.playerID = T1.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Finals MVP' AND T2.year = 2003

question: 列出1950年至1960年间NBA总决赛冠军球队名称及夺冠年份。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T2.year FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 JOIN professional_basketball.series_post AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmIDWinner WHERE T2.round = 'F' AND T2.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1960

question: 列出1946年进入四分之一决赛的NBA球队及其教练。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID, T3.name FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 JOIN professional_basketball.series_post AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmIDWinner JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T1.tmID WHERE T2.round = 'QF' AND T2.year = 1946 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 列出1970年NBA总冠军球队所有球员的全名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.firstName, T3.middleName, T3.lastName FROM professional_basketball.series_post AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmIDWinner = T2.tmID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T3 ON T3.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year = 1970 AND T1.round = 'F' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1970年获得奖项最多的NBA球员来自哪所大学？
query: SELECT college FROM professional_basketball.players WHERE playerID = ( SELECT playerID FROM professional_basketball.awards_players WHERE year = 1970 GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1 )

question: 获得年度最佳新秀奖的NBA球员中最年轻的是谁？列出全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Rookie of the Year' ORDER BY T1.birthDate DESC LIMIT 1

question: 列出1973年第一轮选秀中出生在美国以外国家的NBA球员全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.draft AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.draftRound = 1 AND T1.birthCountry != 'USA' AND T2.draftYear = 1973

question: 2000年全明星球员中进攻篮板占总篮板的百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.o_rebounds) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T2.rebounds) FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year = 2000

question: 列出胜率超过75%的赛季年份、球队名称和教练ID。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.year, T2.name, T1.coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE CAST(T1.won AS REAL) / CAST((T1.won + T1.lost) AS REAL) > 0.75 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 请列出俄克拉荷马城雷霆队的所有教练ID。
query: SELECT DISTINCT coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE name = 'Oklahoma City Thunder' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1990年有多少NBA球员进攻篮板不超过防守篮板的50%？
query: SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players_teams WHERE CAST(oRebounds AS REAL) * 100 / dRebounds <= 50 AND year = 1990 AND lgID = 'NBA'

question: 2000年至2005年间有多少全明星球员抢断不超过10次？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT playerID) FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar WHERE season_id BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 AND steals <= 10

question: 1971年第二轮选秀中获得年度最佳新秀的NBA球员是谁？
query: SELECT T1.playerID FROM professional_basketball.draft AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'Rookie of the Year' AND T1.draftYear = 1971 AND T1.draftRound = 2 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1973年全明星赛中有多少黑人球员？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.season_id = 1973 AND T1.race = 'B'

question: 1947年季后赛四分之一决赛获胜方中防守失分3513分的NBA球队是哪支？
query: SELECT T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.series_post AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmIDWinner = T2.tmID WHERE T1.year = 1947 AND T1.round = 'QF' AND T2.d_pts = 3513 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 请列出1990年后在NBA获得最有价值球员奖的球员ID。
query: SELECT playerID FROM professional_basketball.awards_players WHERE year > 1990 AND award = 'Most Valuable Player' AND lgID = 'NBA'

question: 球员abdulka01在1975年至1980年间为LAL队效力了多少个赛季？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.year) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'LAL' AND T2.year BETWEEN 1975 AND 1980 AND T1.playerID = 'abdulka01'

question: 1969年获得NBA年度最佳教练奖的教练占当年所有教练的百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN award = 'NBA Coach of the Year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches WHERE year = 1969

question: CHS队在1946年和1947年季后赛胜率相差多少个百分点？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1947 AND tmIDWinner = 'CHS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1947 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1946 AND tmIDWinner = 'CHS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 1946 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM professional_basketball.series_post

question: 2010年有多少奖项颁给了在芝加哥上高中的NBA球员？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.award) FROM professional_basketball.awards_players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year = 2010 AND T2.hsCity = 'Chicago'

question: 就读于奥本大学的NBA球员中获得最佳防守二阵的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.award = 'All-Defensive Second Team' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.college = 'Auburn'

question: 请列出1997年抢断最多的前五名全明星球员全名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.season_id = 1997 ORDER BY T2.steals DESC LIMIT 5

question: 1990年NBA总决赛MVP获得者来自哪所大学？
query: SELECT T1.college FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1990 AND T2.award = 'Finals MVP' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1996年全明星赛中罚球命中率超过70%的NBA球员ID有哪些？
query: SELECT playerID FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar WHERE season_id = 1996 AND CAST(ft_made AS REAL) * 100 / ft_attempted > 70

question: 1980年至1983年间三分命中率超过60%的NBA全明星球员有哪些？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.playerID FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1983 AND T1.three_attempted > 0 AND CAST(T1.three_made AS REAL) / T1.three_attempted > 0.6 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 在NBA获奖的教练中有哪些来自STL队？请列出教练ID。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.coachID FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.tmID = 'STL' AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 来自CHI队的教练中有多少人获得过NBA年度最佳教练奖？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.coachID) FROM professional_basketball.coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.tmID = 'CHI' AND T2.award = 'NBA Coach of the Year'

question: 1990年至2000年NBA选秀的球员中谁在全明星赛中得分最高？列出球员姓名。
query: SELECT T3.firstname, T3.lastname FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.draft AS T3 ON T1.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000 AND T3.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T1.points DESC LIMIT 1

question: 来自维克森林大学且在NBA全明星赛中进攻篮板多于防守篮板的球员是谁？请列出球员全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T3 ON T1.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T1.college = 'Wake Forest' AND T2.o_rebounds > T2.d_rebounds AND T3.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 出生在亚特兰大且盖帽最多的NBA球员全名是什么？该球员在哪支球队完成最多盖帽？
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthCity = 'Atlanta' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T2.blocks DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1980年至2000年间排名前五且输掉联赛两次以上的NBA球队有哪些？
query: SELECT T1.name FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.series_post AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmIDLoser AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.rank < 5 AND T2.lgIDLoser > 2 AND T2.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2000 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1991年至2000年间NBA每分钟得分最高的球员来自哪支球队？
query: SELECT tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams WHERE year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2000 AND lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY CAST(points AS REAL) / minutes DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1970年ABA和NBA选秀球员的平均年龄差是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.lgID = 'ABA', 1970 - strftime('%Y', T3.birthDate), 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(IIF(T2.lgID = 'ABA', 1, 0)) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.lgID = 'NBA', 1970 - strftime('%Y', T3.birthDate), 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(IIF(T2.lgID = 'NBA', 1, 0)) FROM professional_basketball.draft AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T3 ON T2.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T1.draftYear = 1970

question: 2011年NBA赛季出场次数最多的球员是谁？
query: SELECT playerID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams WHERE year = 2011 AND lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY GP DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1996年NBA选秀第一轮中有多少球员成为全明星？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.draft AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.draftYear = 1996 AND T1.draftRound = 1 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1997年NBA总决赛MVP效力于哪支球队？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T2.year = 1997 AND T2.award = 'Finals MVP' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 2001年NBA赛季得分王的球队赢了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT T2.W FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.series_post AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmIDLoser AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.year = 2001 ORDER BY T1.o_fgm DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2003年NBA赛季助攻王场均失误是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(T2.turnovers) FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2003 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY T1.playerID, T2.assists ORDER BY T2.assists DESC LIMIT 1

question: Ray Allen在NBA生涯中获得过多少次奖项？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.playerID) FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.awards_players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE first_name = 'Ray' AND last_name = 'Allen' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 2003年获得NBA状元签的球队比上一赛季胜率提升了多少？
query: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2004 THEN T1.won ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2004 THEN T1.won + T1.lost ELSE 0 END)) - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2003 THEN T1.won ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2003 THEN T1.won + T1.lost ELSE 0 END)) FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.draft AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.draftRound = 1 AND T2.draftYear = 2003 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1971年至1975年获得NBA年度最佳教练奖的教练中有多少在POR队？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM professional_basketball.awards_coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 1971 AND 1975 AND T1.award = 'NBA Coach of the Year' AND T2.tmID = 'POR' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA'

question: NBA中LAL队有抢断表现的球员得分占全队百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.steals IS NOT NULL AND T1.tmID = 'LAL', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.tmID) FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1996年抢断最多但未进入季后赛的NBA球员叫什么名字？
query: SELECT T1.playerID FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1996 AND T2.PostGP = 0 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T2.steals DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1988年失误最多且球队未进季后赛的NBA球员ID是什么？
query: SELECT T2.playerID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.PostGP = 0 AND T1.year = 1988 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T1.turnovers DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2000年NBA常规赛未进季后赛的球队中胜率最高的是哪支？
query: SELECT T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.PostGP = 0 AND T1.year = 2000 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY CAST(T2.won AS REAL) / (T2.won + T2.lost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1998年未进季后赛的NBA球队中常规赛得分最多的是哪支？
query: SELECT T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 1998 AND T1.PostGP = 0 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T1.points DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2001年胜场最多但未进季后赛的NBA球队全名是什么？
query: SELECT T2.name FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.PostGP = 0 AND T1.year = 2001 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T2.won DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1997年未进季后赛的NBA球队中总篮板最多的是哪支？
query: SELECT T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.PostGP = 0 AND T1.year = 1997 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T1.rebounds DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1976年第一轮第六顺位被选中的NBA球员当年效力于哪支球队？
query: SELECT T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.draft AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.draftYear = T2.year WHERE T1.draftRound = 1 AND T1.draftSelection = 6 AND T1.draftYear = 1976 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 1998年拥有首轮第12顺位选秀权的NBA球队当年主场胜场是多少？
query: SELECT T2.homeWon FROM professional_basketball.draft AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.draftYear = T2.year WHERE T1.draftRound = 1 AND T1.draftSelection = 12 AND T1.draftYear = 1998 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: NBA全明星历史上篮板最多的球员体重和身高是多少？
query: SELECT T1.weight, T1.height FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T3 ON T1.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T3.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T2.rebounds DESC LIMIT 1

question: NBA全明星历史上篮板最多的球员就读于哪所高中？
query: SELECT T2.highSchool FROM professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T3 ON T2.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T3.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T1.rebounds DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1997年全明星赛中篮板最多的球员效力于哪些NBA球队？列出球队ID。
query: SELECT T2.tmID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN professional_basketball.player_allstar AS T3 ON T3.playerID = T1.playerID WHERE T3.season_id = 1997 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T1.rebounds DESC LIMIT 1

question: 能打F-G位置的最年轻NBA球员效力于哪支球队？
query: SELECT T1.tmID FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players AS T3 ON T2.playerID = T3.playerID WHERE T3.pos = 'F-G' AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T3.birthDate DESC LIMIT 1

question: 参加PBLA比赛最多且毕业于中央密苏里州立大学的球员全名是什么？
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID = 'PBLA' AND T2.GP = 10 AND T1.college = 'Central Missouri State' GROUP BY T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName ORDER BY COUNT(T2.id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1995年全勤的NBA球员中失误最多的是谁？请给出球员全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.middleName, T1.lastName FROM professional_basketball.players AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.GP = 82 AND T2.year = 1995 AND T2.lgID = 'NBA' ORDER BY T2.turnovers DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2011年场场首发的NBA球员中抢断最多的是谁？他效力于哪支球队？
query: SELECT T2.playerID, T1.tmID FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.GP = T2.GS AND T1.lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY T1.tmID, T2.steals ORDER BY T2.steals DESC LIMIT 1

question: 哪些NBA球队整个赛季都使用相同的首发球员？请给出球队全名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.GP = T2.GS AND T1.lgID = 'NBA'

question: 2001年NBA联赛篮板王的生日是什么时候？
query: SELECT birthDate FROM professional_basketball.players WHERE playerID = ( SELECT playerID FROM professional_basketball.players_teams WHERE year = 2001 AND lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY SUM(rebounds) DESC LIMIT 1 )

question: 1997年NBA篮板王效力于哪支球队？请给出球队全名。
query: SELECT T1.name FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.year = 1997 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY SUM(T2.rebounds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2011年拥有不止一名球员篮板超过600个的NBA球队有哪些？请给出球队全名。
query: SELECT T1.name FROM professional_basketball.teams AS T1 INNER JOIN professional_basketball.players_teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2011 AND T2.rebounds > 600 AND T1.lgID = 'NBA' GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.playerID) > 1

question: 莎士比亚1602年之前完成了多少部作品？
query: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM shakespeare.works WHERE Date < 1602

question: 《第十二夜》第一幕有多少场？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id WHERE T2.Act = 1 AND T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 《第十二夜》第一幕第二场的场景描述是什么？
query: SELECT T2.Description FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id WHERE T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night' AND T2.Act = 1 AND T2.Scene = 2

question: 《第十二夜》第一幕比第五幕多多少场？
query: SELECT SUM(IIF(T2.Act = 1, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.Act = 5, 1, 0)) AS more FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id WHERE T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 角色Lord Abergavenny出自莎士比亚哪部作品？请给出简称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Title FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters AS T4 ON T3.character_id = T4.id WHERE T4.CharName = 'Lord Abergavenny'

question: 请列出莎士比亚作品《第十二夜》中所有角色的名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T4.CharName FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters AS T4 ON T3.character_id = T4.id WHERE T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 《第十二夜》第一幕第一场有多少段落？
query: SELECT COUNT(T3.id) FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id WHERE T2.Act = 1 AND T2.Scene = 1 AND T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 请列出《第十二夜》第一幕第一场中所有段落的文本内容。
query: SELECT T3.PlainText FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id WHERE T2.Act = 1 AND T2.Scene = 1 AND T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 包含角色Lord Abergavenny的段落有多少？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM shakespeare.paragraphs AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters AS T2 ON T1.character_id = T2.id WHERE T2.CharName = 'Lord Abergavenny'

question: 请列出包含角色描述为'son to Tamora'的段落ID。
query: SELECT T1.id FROM shakespeare.paragraphs AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters AS T2 ON T1.character_id = T2.id WHERE T2.Description = 'son to Tamora'

question: 场景描述'OLIVIA'S house.'在《第十二夜》中出现了多少次？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.id) FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id WHERE T2.Description = 'OLIVIA''S house.' AND T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 《第十二夜》中有多少个角色？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T4.id) FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters AS T4 ON T3.character_id = T4.id WHERE T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 莎士比亚哪部作品的角色最多？请给出作品标题。
query: SELECT T.Title FROM ( SELECT T1.Title, COUNT(T3.character_id) AS num FROM shakespeare.works T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters T4 ON T3.character_id = T4.id GROUP BY T3.character_id, T1.Title ) T ORDER BY T.num DESC LIMIT 1

question: 《第十二夜》平均每幕有多少场？
query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.Scene) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Act) FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id WHERE T1.Title = 'Twelfth Night'

question: 莎士比亚何时写了第一首诗？
query: SELECT MIN(Date) FROM shakespeare.works WHERE GenreType = 'Poem'

question: 请给出角色'Earl of Westmoreland'的缩写名。
query: SELECT DISTINCT Abbrev FROM shakespeare.characters WHERE CharName = 'Earl of Westmoreland'

question: 哪个章节段落最多？请给出该章节的描述。
query: SELECT T1.Description FROM shakespeare.chapters AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.chapter_id GROUP BY T1.id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 《泰特斯·安特洛尼克斯》中有多少个角色？

question: 莎士比亚1594年作品中悲剧场景占所有场景的百分比是多少？

question: 在莎士比亚作品章节描述为'The sea-coast.'中，除舞台指导外，出现恰好5次的角色叫什么名字？

question: 在莎士比亚1600年前的悲剧作品中，列出包含角色Tybalt的作品标题。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.title FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters AS T4 ON T3.character_id = T4.id WHERE T1.Date < 1600 AND T1.GenreType = 'Tragedy' AND T4.CharName = 'Tybalt'

question: 列出莎士比亚中创作年份高于所有作品平均年份89%的作品的章节ID。
query: SELECT T2.id FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id WHERE T1.Date > ( SELECT AVG(Date) FROM shakespeare.works ) * 0.89

question: 莎士比亚喜剧中含有角色名为'Antonio'的作品占所有喜剧作品的百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM shakespeare.works WHERE GenreType = 'Comedy') FROM shakespeare.works AS T1 INNER JOIN shakespeare.chapters AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.work_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.paragraphs AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.chapter_id INNER JOIN shakespeare.characters AS T4 ON T3.character_id = T4.id WHERE T1.GenreType = 'Comedy' AND T4.CharName = 'Antonio'

question: 列出Yelp上Mesa市提供酒精饮品的商家。
query: SELECT T1.business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Attributes AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.attribute_id WHERE T1.city = 'Mesa' AND T3.attribute_name = 'Alcohol'

question: 基于凤凰城的Yelp商家，计算有趣投票数低的商家百分比。
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.review_votes_funny = 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Reviews AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T1.city = 'Phoenix'

question: Yelp上购物类商家与宠物类商家的数量比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.category_name = 'Shopping' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.category_name = 'Pets' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS radio FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id

question: Yelp上银行和信用合作社类别下注册了多少商家？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id WHERE T1.category_name = 'Banks & Credit Unions'

question: Yelp商家编号12周一几点开门？
query: SELECT T1.opening_time FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T2 ON T1.day_id = T2.day_id WHERE T1.business_id = 12 AND T2.day_of_week = 'Monday'

question: Yelp上适合儿童的商家有多少家？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.attribute_id = T2.attribute_id WHERE T1.attribute_name = 'Good for Kids' AND T2.attribute_value = 'true'

question: 根据用户评论，找出Yelp上Gilbert市最受欢迎且最吸引人的活跃商家。
query: SELECT business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE city = 'Gilbert' AND active = 'true' AND review_count = 'High' ORDER BY stars DESC LIMIT 1

question: 找出Yelp上Ahwatukee地区5星评分的商家，并指出其类别。
query: SELECT T1.business_id, T3.category_name FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.category_id WHERE T1.city = 'Ahwatukee' AND T1.stars = 5

question: 亚利桑那州Avondale市已关闭的Yelp商家中，获得极佳体验评分的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stars > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(stars) FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE city = 'Avondale' AND active = 'false'

question: 找出2004年开始使用Yelp的用户，他们是否是Yelp精英会员？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.user_id FROM public_review_platform.Users AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Elite AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_yelping_since_year = 2004

question: 在Yelp用户给商家的所有5星评论中，长评论占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN review_length = 'Long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(review_length) FROM public_review_platform.Reviews WHERE review_stars = 5

question: 在所有平均评分至少4星及以上的Yelp用户中，没有粉丝的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN user_fans = 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users WHERE user_average_stars >= 4

question: Yelp商家编号2收到了多少条短提示？
query: SELECT COUNT(business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Tips WHERE business_id = 2 AND tip_length = 'Short'

question: 找出Yelp上Black Canyon City市评论数高于平均水平的商家的营业时间。
query: SELECT T2.opening_time, T2.closing_time FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city = 'Black Canyon City' AND T1.review_count > ( SELECT AVG(review_count) FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE city = 'Black Canyon City' )

question: 在收到高级别称赞的Yelp用户中，收到cute类型称赞的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.compliment_type = 'cute' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Compliments AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users_Compliments AS T2 ON T1.compliment_id = T2.compliment_id WHERE T2.number_of_compliments = 'High'

question: 列出Yelp上没有任何属性的商家数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Attributes WHERE attribute_value IN ('none', 'no', 'false')

question: 列出Yelp上有中等长度评论的商家所在的城市名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.city FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Reviews AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T2.review_length = 'Medium'

question: 在评论长度短的Yelp商家中，哪些位于凤凰城？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Reviews AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T1.city = 'Phoenix' AND T2.review_length = 'Short'

question: 在粉丝数中等的Yelp用户中，有多少人收到了来自其他用户的高级别称赞？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users_Compliments AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T2.number_of_compliments = 'High' AND T1.user_fans = 'Medium'

question: 在收到低级别称赞的Yelp用户中，哪些是2012年加入的？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.user_id FROM public_review_platform.Users AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users_Compliments AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_yelping_since_year = 2012 AND T2.number_of_compliments = 'Low'

question: 在没有属性的Yelp商家中，有多少位于Gilbert市？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T2.city = 'Gilbert' AND T1.attribute_value IN ('None', 'no', 'false')

question: 在Yelp商家中，有多少具备full_bar属性？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T1.attribute_value = 'full_bar'

question: 列出Yelp上凌晨1点开门的商家所在的州。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.state FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T2.opening_time = '1AM'

question: 列出Yelp商家5的类别名称。
query: SELECT T1.category_name FROM public_review_platform.Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id WHERE T2.business_id = 5

question: 列出Yelp上获得photos类型称赞的用户ID。
query: SELECT T2.user_id FROM public_review_platform.Compliments AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users_Compliments AS T2 ON T1.compliment_id = T2.compliment_id WHERE T1.compliment_type = 'photos'

question: 计算Yelp中等长度提示的百分比，并列出中等长度提示用户加入Yelp的时间。
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.tip_length = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.tip_length), T2.user_yelping_since_year FROM public_review_platform.Tips AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id

question: 计算Yelp上Mesa市商家占所有商家的百分比，以及这些商家的属性值是什么。
query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.city) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business ), T2.attribute_value FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T1.city = 'Mesa'

question: 列出Yelp上凌晨12点关门的商家所在的州。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.state FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T2.closing_time = '12AM'

question: 在Yelp上提供啤酒和葡萄酒的商家中，有多少位于Peoria市？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T2.city = 'Peoria' AND T1.attribute_value = 'beer_and_wine'

question: 在收到高级别称赞的Yelp用户中，哪些是最早加入Yelp的？
query: SELECT T2.user_id FROM public_review_platform.Users AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users_Compliments AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T2.number_of_compliments = 'High' AND T1.user_yelping_since_year = ( SELECT MIN(user_yelping_since_year) FROM public_review_platform.Users )

question: Yelp上哪个商家ID获得的评论最多？
query: SELECT business_id FROM public_review_platform.Reviews GROUP BY business_id ORDER BY COUNT(user_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Yelp上哪一年精英用户最多？
query: SELECT year_id FROM public_review_platform.Elite GROUP BY year_id ORDER BY COUNT(user_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Yelp上有多少5星商家的评论获得了极多有趣投票？
query: SELECT COUNT(business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Reviews WHERE review_stars = 5 AND review_votes_funny = 'Uber'

question: Yelp上有多少用户的评论获得了极多有趣投票？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Reviews WHERE review_votes_funny = 'Uber'

question: Yelp上哪个商家ID的营业时间最短？
query: SELECT business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours ORDER BY closing_time - opening_time LIMIT 1

question: 找出Yelp上全天24小时营业的商家ID。
query: SELECT DISTINCT business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours WHERE day_id >= 1 AND day_id < 8 AND opening_time = closing_time

question: 对于Yelp上酒店和旅行类商家，提示长度是否影响点赞数？
query: SELECT T3.tip_length, SUM(T3.likes) AS likes FROM public_review_platform.Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Tips AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T1.category_name = 'Hotels & Travel' GROUP BY T3.tip_length

question: 有多少Yelp用户在所有评论类别中都获得了极多投票？他们的平均星级是多少？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.user_id) AS USER_IDS, T2.user_average_stars FROM public_review_platform.Reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.review_votes_funny = 'Uber' AND T1.review_votes_useful = 'Uber' AND T1.review_votes_cool = 'Uber'

question: Yelp上全天24小时营业的商家好评与差评的比例是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.stars BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.stars BETWEEN 1 AND 2.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id

question: 列出Yelp上被用户评论最多的10个商家ID，并列出排名前三的商家类别。
query: SELECT T2.business_id, T3.category_name FROM public_review_platform.Reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_categories AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.category_id GROUP BY T2.business_id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.user_id) DESC LIMIT 10

question: 亚利桑那州有多少Yelp商家平均评论星级低于3星？
query: SELECT COUNT(business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE business_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T1.business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Reviews AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T1.state = 'AZ' GROUP BY T1.business_id HAVING SUM(T2.review_stars) / COUNT(T2.user_id) < 3 )

question: Yelp用户中未成为精英会员的百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST((( SELECT COUNT(user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users ) - ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Elite )) AS REAL) * 100 / ( SELECT COUNT(user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users )

question: 拥有极多粉丝的Yelp用户最常收到什么类型的称赞？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.compliment_type FROM public_review_platform.Users AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Users_Compliments AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Compliments AS T3 ON T2.compliment_id = T3.compliment_id WHERE T1.user_fans = 'Uber'

question: 拥有极多粉丝的Yelp用户平均需要多少年才能成为精英用户？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.year_id - T1.user_yelping_since_year) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Elite AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_fans = 'Uber'

question: Yelp用户平均需要多少年才能升级为精英用户？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.year_id - T1.user_yelping_since_year) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Elite AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id

question: Mesa市有多少Yelp商家营业超过8小时？活跃商家的百分比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.active = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.business_id) AS ACT FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id WHERE T1.city = 'Mesa'

question: 凤凰城下午5点后营业的活跃Yelp商家有多少？列出这些商家排名前三的类别名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T4.category_name FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T4 ON T3.category_id = T4.category_id WHERE T2.active = 'true' AND T2.city = 'Phoenix' AND T1.opening_time >= '5PM' LIMIT 3

question: 哪位Yelp用户对提供外卖服务的商家评论最多？
query: SELECT T3.user_id FROM public_review_platform.Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.attribute_id = T2.attribute_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Reviews AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T1.attribute_name = 'Delivery' GROUP BY T3.user_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.business_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 对于每周营业不超过30小时的活跃Yelp商家，平均评论数是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(T3.user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Reviews AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T1.active = 'true' GROUP BY T2.closing_time - T2.opening_time HAVING SUM(T2.closing_time - T2.opening_time) < 30

question: Yelp上有多少商家早上8点到下午6点营业？
query: SELECT DISTINCT business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours WHERE opening_time = '8AM' AND closing_time = '6PM'

question: 列出Yelp上每周六早上10点开门的商家ID。
query: SELECT DISTINCT business_id FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours WHERE day_id = 6 AND opening_time = '10AM'

question: 列出Yelp上早8点到晚6点营业的商家ID和营业日。
query: SELECT DISTINCT business_id, day_id FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours WHERE opening_time = '8AM' AND closing_time = '6PM'

question: Yelp上有多少商家评分超过4星？
query: SELECT COUNT(business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE stars > 4

question: Yelp上周日营业的商家属于哪些类别？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.category_name FROM public_review_platform.Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T4 ON T3.day_id = T4.day_id WHERE T4.day_of_week = 'Sunday' AND T3.opening_time <> ''

question: 请列出Yelp上宠物类商家的营业日。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T4.day_of_week FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T4 ON T3.day_id = T4.day_id WHERE T2.category_name = 'Pets'

question: 请列出Yelp上医生类商家的关门时间和营业日。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.closing_time, T4.day_of_week FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T4 ON T3.day_id = T4.day_id WHERE T2.category_name = 'Doctors'

question: 在周一至周六的工作日中，哪类Yelp商家营业天数最多？
query: SELECT T2.category_name FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T4 ON T3.day_id = T4.day_id GROUP BY T2.category_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T3.day_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 列出Yelp上艺术与娱乐类商家在周日的关门时间及商家ID。
query: SELECT T1.business_id, T3.closing_time FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Days AS T4 ON T3.day_id = T4.day_id WHERE T2.category_name = 'Arts & Entertainment' AND T4.day_of_week = 'Sunday'

question: Yelp上DJ类商家中评分低于5星的有多少家？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T3 ON T2.category_id = T3.category_id WHERE T3.category_name = 'DJs' AND T1.stars < 5

question: 列出Yelp上早7点开门、晚8点关门的活跃商家ID。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T4.business_id FROM public_review_platform.Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T4 ON T3.business_id = T4.business_id WHERE T4.active = 'true' AND T3.opening_time = '7AM' AND T3.closing_time = '8PM'

question: Yelp上体育场馆类商家中评分最高的有多少家？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T2.category_name = 'Stadiums & Arenas' AND T3.stars = ( SELECT MAX(stars) FROM public_review_platform.Business )

question: 在亚利桑那州活跃的Yelp商家中，有多少家在中午12点后开始营业？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.business_id) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T4 ON T3.category_id = T4.category_id WHERE T2.active = 'true' AND T2.state = 'AZ' AND T1.opening_time > '12PM'

question: 请列出Yelp用户16328评论过的商家类别名称。
query: SELECT T1.category_name FROM public_review_platform.Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Tips AS T3 ON T2.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T3.user_id = 16328

question: 食品类Yelp商家有多少？列出这些商家，并计算其中评分低于2星的百分比。
query: SELECT T3.business_id, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.stars < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T3.stars) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T2 ON T1.category_id = T2.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T2.category_name = 'Food' GROUP BY T3.business_id

question: 计算食品类Yelp商家中早7点到晚8点营业的占所有同时段营业商家的百分比。
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.category_name = 'Food' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T3.category_name) FROM public_review_platform.Business_Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Categories AS T3 ON T1.category_id = T3.category_id INNER JOIN public_review_platform.Business_Hours AS T4 ON T2.business_id = T4.business_id WHERE T4.opening_time = '7AM' AND T4.closing_time = '8PM'

question: 列出Cave Creek市活跃Yelp商家按评论数级别（高、中、低）分类的数量。
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN review_count = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high , SUM(CASE WHEN review_count = 'Medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Medium , SUM(CASE WHEN review_count = 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE city = 'Cave Creek' AND active = 'true'

question: 计算2005年至2014年间Yelp用户的年均增长量。
query: SELECT AVG(user_id) FROM public_review_platform.Users WHERE user_yelping_since_year >= 2005 AND user_yelping_since_year <= 2015

question: Yelp上评论数低的商家中活跃与不活跃的比例是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN active = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN active = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS radio FROM public_review_platform.Business WHERE review_count = 'Low'

question: 列出任意5个2006年成为Yelp精英用户的用户ID。

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN movie_title = 'Cars' THEN CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN movie_title = 'Cars 2' THEN CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM disney.movies_total_gross

question: 迪士尼导演Chris Buck最新执导的电影是哪部？他执导的电影中哪部在票房上更成功？请使用当前票房进行比较。
query: SELECT movie_title, MAX(CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL)) FROM disney.movies_total_gross WHERE movie_title IN ( SELECT T1.movie_title FROM disney.movies_total_gross AS T1 INNER JOIN disney.director AS T2 ON T1.movie_title = T2.name WHERE T2.director = 'Chris Buck' )

question: 列出迪士尼通胀调整后票房排名前五的电影，计算它们占迪士尼当前总票房的百分比。
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) > ( SELECT CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) FROM disney.movies_total_gross ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4 ) THEN CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CAST(REPLACE(trim(inflation_adjusted_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL)) FROM disney.movies_total_gross

question: 在迪士尼导演Gary Trousdale执导的所有电影中，实际票房超过1亿美元的占百分之多少？
query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(REPLACE(trim(T1.total_gross, '$'), ',', '') AS REAL) > 100000000 THEN T1.movie_title ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.movie_title) FROM disney.movies_total_gross AS T1 INNER JOIN disney.director AS T2 ON T1.movie_title = T2.name WHERE T2.director = 'Gary Trousdale'

question: Sac State Union的精确位置是什么？

question: 列出Dr Pepper Snapple Group生产的根汁啤酒品牌，并计算其2014年至2016年间的购买占比。

question: River City与Frostie的销售额百分比差是多少？
