query: SELECT T2.OBJ_CLASS, AVG(T1.W), AVG(T1.H) FROM image_and_language.IMG_OBJ AS T1 INNER JOIN image_and_language.OBJ_CLASSES AS T2 ON T1.OBJ_CLASS_ID = T2.OBJ_CLASS_ID WHERE T1.IMG_ID = 47 GROUP BY T2.OBJ_CLASS

question: 列出所有非美国籍且出生于 1990 年的球员的名字和姓氏。
query: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM hockey.Master WHERE birthYear = 1990 AND birthCountry != 'USA'

question: 列出所有擅长左右手且打前锋位置的球员的名字。
query: SELECT nameGiven FROM hockey.Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND pos = 'F'

question: 有哪些球员不在名人堂名单中？
query: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM hockey.Master WHERE hofID IS NULL

question: 谁是在世的最年轻球员？请给出他的名字和出生日期。
query: SELECT nameGiven, birthYear, birthMon, birthDay FROM hockey.Master WHERE deathYear IS NULL ORDER BY birthYear DESC, birthMon DESC, birthDay DESC LIMIT 1

question: 对于所有已故且擅长左右手的球员，列出球员姓名及其去世时的年龄。
query: SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM hockey.Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL

question: 列出在 2000 年至 2005 年间效力过超过两支球队的门将姓名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year >= 2000 AND T2.year <= 2005 GROUP BY T2.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.tmID) > 2

question: 身高大于 72 英寸的球员的平均体重是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(weight) FROM hockey.Master WHERE height > 72

question: 列出在所有赛季中总上场时间超过 5000 分钟的门将名字及其出生国家。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameGiven, T1.birthCountry FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.nameGiven, T1.birthCountry HAVING SUM(T2.Min) > 5000

question: 列出既在 PCHA 联盟又在 NHL 联盟效力过的门将姓名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID IN ('PCHA', 'NHL') GROUP BY T2.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.lgID) > 1

question: 按姓氏列出所有已故门将，并列出他们上场时间最多的那个赛季。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, T2.Min FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T2.Min = (SELECT MAX(Min) FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = T1.playerID)

question: 列出所有空网球进球数 10 个及以上的门将姓名及其所在赛季。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName , T2.year FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.ENG >= 10

question: 找出在所有射门中被进球率最低的门将，列出姓名和所在赛季。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE CAST(T2.GA AS REAL) / T2.SA IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(T2.GA AS REAL) / T2.SA LIMIT 1

question: 列出 2005 赛季上场且身高低于 72 英寸的所有门将姓名，以及他们效力的所有球队名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T2.year = 2005 AND T1.height < 72

question: 给出球员 ID 为 'aubinje01' 的昵称，并列出他效力过的所有球队及赛季。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameNick, T3.year, T3.name FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.playerID = 'aubinje01'

question: 列出参赛赛季最多的门将姓名，并显示他每个赛季的平均上场时间。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, AVG(T2.Min) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = ( SELECT playerID FROM hockey.Goalies GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY COUNT(playerID) DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year

question: 找出在自己把守球门期间，完封场次占总失球数 5% 的门将及其所在赛季。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT playerID, year FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE CAST(SHO AS REAL) / GA > 0.05 ) AS T2 ON T2.playerID = T1.playerID

question: 列出逝世地点与出生地点不同的已故球员姓名，按出生年份排序。
query: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM hockey.Master WHERE birthCountry != deathCountry ORDER BY birthYear

question: 有哪些球员既在 NHL 又在 WHA 打过球？列出他们的名字、首次进入 NHL 的年份和首次进入 WHA 的年份。
query: SELECT nameGiven, firstNHL, firstWHA FROM hockey.Master WHERE firstNHL IS NOT NULL AND firstWHA IS NOT NULL

question: 列出仍在世的能打两个位置的球员，显示他们的名字和所打的位置。
query: SELECT firstName, lastName, pos FROM hockey.Master WHERE deathYear IS NULL AND pos LIKE '%/%'

question: 身高最高的球员的昵称是什么？如果他已离开 NHL，请给出他最后一个 NHL 赛季。
query: SELECT nameNick, lastNHL FROM hockey.Master ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1990 年及以后出生的球员平均身高是多少？与 1990 年之前出生的球员平均身高进行比较。
query: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN birthYear < 1990 THEN height END) AS avg_before_1990, AVG(CASE WHEN birthYear >= 1990 THEN height END) AS avg_from_1990 FROM hockey.Master

question: 列出擅长左手并且退役后成为教练的门将姓名，以及他之前效力的所有球队。
query: SELECT DISTINCT firstName, lastName, T3.name FROM hockey.Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T2.playerID = T1.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T1.lgID = T3.lgID WHERE T1.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T2.coachID IS NOT NULL AND T2.shootCatch = 'L' AND T2.pos = 'G'

question: 当波士顿棕熊队排名第一时，上场的门将及其赛季是哪些？
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.year FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T3.name = 'Boston Bruins' AND T3.rank = 1 AND T1.pos = 'G'

question: 在仍在世的门将中，首次 NHL 赛季在 1950 年之前的球员，列出他们效力过的球队名称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.name FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T2.lgID = T3.lgID AND T2.year = T3.year WHERE T1.deathYear IS NULL AND T1.firstNHL < 1950

question: 列出所有退役后成为教练的球员，给出教练的名字以及他们执教过的球队和年份。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.nameGiven, T3.name, T3.year FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T2.coachID = T1.coachID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T2.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T2.coachID IS NOT NULL

question: 在那些从未做过球员的教练中，胜率最高的是谁？请提供教练名字和他执教的球队。
query: SELECT T2.nameGiven, T3.name FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T2.coachID = T1.coachID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T1.lgID = T3.lgID WHERE T1.coachID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(T1.w AS REAL) / T1.g DESC LIMIT 1

question: 历史上执教 DET 队表现最好的教练是谁？他的胜率是多少？请给出教练姓名和执教年份。
query: SELECT CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / T2.G AS win_pct, T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.tmID = 'DET' ORDER BY CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / T2.G DESC LIMIT 1

question: 哪位教练在 MTL 队执教的赛季最多？给出他的名字、出生日期和之前执教过的所有球队。
query: SELECT T2.nameGiven, T2.birthYear, T2.birthMon, T2.birthDay, T3.name FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.coachID = ( SELECT coachID FROM hockey.Coaches WHERE tmID = 'MTL' GROUP BY coachID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT year) DESC LIMIT 1 )

question: 列出至少两个赛季输球场数多于赢球场数的门将，显示球员姓名和他当时效力的球队。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.pos = 'G' AND T2.L > T2.W GROUP BY T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name HAVING COUNT(T3.year) >= 2

question: 对于所有 1987 年出生且擅长左右手的门将，计算他们每个赛季的胜率。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / T2.GP FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthYear = 1987 AND T1.shootCatch IS NULL

question: 球员'aebisda01'的名字是什么？计算他作为门将的所有比赛的平均上场时间（分钟）。
query: SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL) / SUM(T2.GP) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = 'aebisda01' GROUP BY T1.nameGiven

question: 列出所有在世的胜率超过50%的门将，请列出他们的姓和名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NULL GROUP BY T1.playerID HAVING CAST(SUM(T2.W) AS REAL) / SUM(T2.GP) > 0.5

question: 有多少球员和教练在去世后获得了奖项？
query: SELECT COUNT(note) FROM hockey.AwardsMisc WHERE note = 'posthumous'

question: 在1983年获奖的球员中，有多少人是守门员？
query: SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM hockey.AwardsPlayers WHERE pos = 'G' AND year = 1983

question: 在2007年担任临时教练的教练有多少人？
query: SELECT COUNT(coachID) FROM hockey.Coaches WHERE year = 2007 AND notes = 'interim'

question: 在1977年常规赛中有多少次完封？
query: SELECT COUNT(year) FROM hockey.CombinedShutouts WHERE year = 1977 AND `R/P` = 'R'

question: 2005年，有多少支球队在对手撤下门将时取得了进球？
query: SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE year = 2005 AND ENG IS NOT NULL

question: 请列出NHL联盟在有门将上场时记录射门数的年份。
query: SELECT DISTINCT year FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE lgID = 'NHL' AND SA IS NOT NULL

question: 有多少支球队的季后赛胜场数和季后赛负场数相同？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tmID) FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE PostW = PostL

question: 请列出1978年入选名人堂的人员姓名。
query: SELECT name FROM hockey.HOF WHERE year = 1978

question: 名人堂中有多少人属于建设者类别？
query: SELECT COUNT(hofID) FROM hockey.HOF WHERE category = 'Builder'

question: 在1980年后进入名人堂的人中，有多少属于“球员”类别？
query: SELECT COUNT(hofID) FROM hockey.HOF WHERE year > 1980 AND category = 'Player'

question: 请列出2007年入选名人堂的球员的昵称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameNick FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID WHERE T2.year = 2007

question: 最高的球员入选名人堂了吗？如果入选了，请列出他入选的年份。
query: SELECT CASE WHEN T1.hofID IS NULL THEN 'NO' ELSE T2.year END FROM hockey.Master AS T1 LEFT JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID WHERE T1.height = ( SELECT MAX(height) FROM hockey.Master )

question: 请列出出生于加拿大的教练所获得的奖项。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.award FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.birthCountry = 'Canada'

question: 在单赛季球队胜场数超过30场的教练中，有多少人出生在美国？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.coachID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.W > 30 AND T1.birthCountry = 'USA'

question: 在执教过NHL联盟球队的教练中，有多少人来自加拿大？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.coachID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.lgID = 'NHL' AND T1.birthCountry = 'Canada'

question: 请列出1952年出生的教练所获得的奖项。
query: SELECT T2.award FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.birthYear = 1952

question: 在1940年获奖的教练中，有多少人出生于多伦多？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.coachID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 1940 AND T1.birthCity = 'Toronto'

question: 在1940年之后获奖的教练中，有多少人已经去世？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.coachID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T2.year > 1940

question: 请列出曾在NHL联盟执教且已去世的教练所获得的奖项。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.award FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T2.lgID = 'NHL'

question: 在入选名人堂的教练中，有多少人体重超过195？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID WHERE T1.weight > 195

question: 在既当过球员又当过教练的人中，有多少人入选了名人堂？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.playerID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID WHERE T1.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL

question: 请列出在1970年获奖的球员的出生城市。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthCity FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1970

question: 有多少出生在多伦多的球员获得过最佳新秀奖？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.playerID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.birthCity = 'Toronto'

question: 在获得过最佳新秀奖的球员中，有多少人已经去世？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.playerID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL

question: 在马萨诸塞州去世的球员中，有多少人获得过奖项？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathState = 'MA'

question: 请列出获得最佳新秀奖且出生于三月的球员的昵称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameNick FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.birthMon = 3

question: 在七月和八月出生的球员中，有多少人入选了名人堂？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.playerID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID WHERE T1.birthMon IN (7, 8)

question: 哪一年出生的球员获得的奖项总数最多？
query: SELECT T1.birthYear FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.birthYear ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 获得奖项最多的球员来自哪个国家？
query: SELECT T1.birthCountry FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.birthCountry ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 哪个国家进入名人堂的球员最多？
query: SELECT T1.birthCountry FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID GROUP BY T1.birthCountry ORDER BY COUNT(T1.playerID) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 请列出出生于加拿大并获得最佳新秀奖的球员所打的位置。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.pos FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthCountry = 'Canada' AND T2.award = 'All-Rookie'

question: 入选名人堂的所有教练的平均BMI是多少？
query: SELECT SUM(T1.weight / (T1.height * T1.height)) / COUNT(T1.coachID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID

question: 在入选名人堂的所有球员中，美国球员的占比是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN T1.playerID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.playerID) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.HOF AS T2 ON T1.hofID = T2.hofID

question: 球员ID为'healygl01'的球员打了多少年？
query: SELECT MAX(year) - MIN(year) FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = 'healygl01'

question: 球员ID为'roypa01'的球员在1992年效力于哪支球队？请给出球队ID。
query: SELECT tmID FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = 'roypa01' AND year = 1992

question: 球员ID为'rutlewa01'的球员在1967年总共参加了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT GP FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = 'rutlewa01' AND year = 1967

question: 显示球员ID为'valiqst01'的球员在2007赛季的比赛中上场了多少分钟。
query: SELECT Min FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = 'valiqst01' AND year = 2007

question: 球员ID为'vanbijo01'的球员在1990赛季赢了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT W FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = 'vanbijo01' AND year = 1990

question: 球员ID为'vernomi01'的球员在1998赛季有多少场比赛以平局或加时负告终？
query: SELECT `T/OL` FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE playerID = 'vernomi01' AND year = 1998

question: 获得1933年全明星第二阵容的教练当年赢了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT SUM(T1.W) FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 1933 AND T2.award = 'Second Team All-Star'

question: 传奇ID为'P194502'的人是否亲自出席了名人堂入选仪式？
query: SELECT IIF(T1.note = 'posthumous', 'YES', 'NO') FROM hockey.AwardsMisc AS T1 RIGHT JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.legendsID = 'P194502'

question: Mike Antonovich 打什么位置？
query: SELECT T1.pos FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.firstName = 'Mike' AND T1.lastName = 'Antonovich'

question: 1998年与Dave Lewis共同执教的教练，他的出生地是哪里？
query: SELECT T1.birthCountry, T1.birthState, T1.birthCity FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 1998 AND T2.notes = 'co-coach with Dave Lewis'

question: 在比赛中作为第三门将出场的球员中，体重最大的是谁？请给出全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.stint = 3 ORDER BY T1.weight DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在职业生涯中打进10个空网球的球员中，谁最高？请显示全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T2.playerID, T1.height HAVING SUM(T2.ENG) >= 10 ORDER BY T1.height DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2010年完封次数最多的门将，他的接球手是哪只？
query: SELECT T1.shootCatch FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2010 GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.SHO) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在2002赛季失球数超过150个的门将中，谁是最年轻的？
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2002 AND T2.GA > 150 GROUP BY T2.playerID, T1.birthYear, T1.birthMon, T1.birthDay ORDER BY T1.birthYear DESC, T1.birthMon DESC, T1.birthDay DESC LIMIT 1

question: NJD队历史上扑救次数最多的门将是谁？请给出全名。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'NJD' GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.SA - T2.GA) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2010赛季季后赛空网球进球最多的球队是哪些？请列出球队名称。
query: SELECT T2.name FROM hockey.Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T1.year = 2010 GROUP BY T2.name ORDER BY SUM(PostENG) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1995年季后赛完封次数最多的球队，当年获得了多少积分？
query: SELECT T3.Pts FROM hockey.Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T1.year = 1995 GROUP BY T1.tmID ORDER BY SUM(T1.PostSHO) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2009赛季胜率最高的教练是谁？他的昵称是什么？
query: SELECT T2.coachID, T1.nameNick FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 2009 ORDER BY CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / (T2.W + T2.L) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2011年多打少成功率最高的球队，其当赛季的教练是谁？请给出全名。
query: SELECT T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.year = 2011 ORDER BY CAST(T2.PPG AS REAL) / T2.PPC DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在斯坦利杯决赛历史上，球员ID为'broadpu01'的球员在1922年打了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT GP FROM hockey.ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'broadpu01' AND YEAR = 1922

question: 球员ID为'cleghsp01'的球员有多少年打入过斯坦利杯决赛？
query: SELECT COUNT(year) FROM hockey.ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'cleghsp01'

question: 球员ID为'dyeba01'的球员在1921年斯坦利杯决赛中打进了多少球？
query: SELECT G FROM hockey.ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'dyeba01' AND year = 1921

question: 谁在斯坦利杯决赛单场比赛中助攻最多？
query: SELECT playerID FROM hockey.ScoringSC ORDER BY A DESC LIMIT 1

question: 球员ID为'adamsja01'的球员在1920年效力于哪个联盟？
query: SELECT lgID FROM hockey.ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'adamsja01' AND year = 1920

question: 球员ID为'hartgi01'的球员在斯坦利杯决赛中打什么位置？
query: SELECT DISTINCT pos FROM hockey.ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'hartgi01'

question: 2011年季后赛有三名不同门将的球队，在常规赛赢了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT SUM(T2.W) FROM hockey.Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.year = 2011 GROUP BY T1.tmID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) = 3

question: 2008年季后赛被射门次数最多的门将是哪一年出生的？
query: SELECT T1.birthYear FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2008 ORDER BY T2.PostSA DESC LIMIT 1

question: Don Waddell 退役成为NHL教练后，有多少年？
query: SELECT MAX(T2.year) - MIN(T2.year) FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.firstName = 'Don' AND T1.lastName = 'Waddell'

question: 1996年完封次数最多的门将，接球手是哪只？
query: SELECT T1.shootCatch FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1996 GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.SHO) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1965赛季失球最多的门将，他的生日是什么时候？
query: SELECT T1.birthYear, T1.birthMon, birthDay FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1965 ORDER BY T2.GA DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1981赛季场上正负值最高的球员，他的全名是什么？
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1981 GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.`+/-`) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 21世纪多打少进球最多的球员体重是多少？
query: SELECT T1.weight FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year > 2000 GROUP BY T1.playerID, T1.weight ORDER BY SUM(T2.PPG) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1989年打进7个少打多进球的球员，他的惯用手是哪只？
query: SELECT T1.shootCatch FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1989 GROUP BY T2.playerID HAVING SUM(T2.SHG) = 7

question: Cam Neely 在1990年有多少次射正？
query: SELECT T2.SOG FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.firstName = 'Cam' AND T1.lastName = 'Neely' AND T2.year = '1990'

question: 2003年替补席违例罚时最多的球队，其教练是谁？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T2.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T1.year = '2003' GROUP BY T3.firstName, T3.lastName ORDER BY SUM(T1.BenchMinor) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 体重超过190磅的门将中，谁在1978赛季失球最多？
query: SELECT T1.playerID FROM hockey.Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year = '1978' AND T2.weight > 190 ORDER BY T1.GA DESC LIMIT 1

question: Alain Vigneault 从2006赛季开始执教温哥华加人队后，胜率提升了多少？
query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2006 THEN CAST(T1.W AS REAL) * 100 / (T1.W + T1.L) ELSE 0 END) - ( SELECT CAST(W AS REAL) * 100 / (W + L) FROM hockey.Teams WHERE year = '2005' AND name = 'Vancouver Canucks' ) FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T2.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T1.name = 'Vancouver Canucks' AND T3.firstName = 'Alain' AND T3.lastName = 'Vigneault'

question: 2011年季后赛防守成功率最高的门将，他的传奇ID是什么？
query: SELECT T2.legendsID FROM hockey.Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.year = 2011 ORDER BY 1 - CAST(T1.PostGA AS REAL) / T1.PostSA DESC LIMIT 1

question: 有多少球员在退役后成为了教练？
query: SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM hockey.Master WHERE playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NOT NULL

question: 平局次数最多的球队中，不在场上的球员或教练犯了多少次规？请标明球队名称。
query: SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM hockey.Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1

question: 胜场最多的教练最常获得哪个NHL奖项？
query: SELECT award FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.lgID = T2.lgID WHERE T1.lgID = 'NHL' GROUP BY T2.coachID, T2.award ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 输球场次最多的球队，其多打少成功率是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(PPG) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(PPC) FROM hockey.Teams GROUP BY tmID ORDER BY SUM(L) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1950年至1980年间，平均每年有多少球员进入名人堂？
query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(name) AS REAL) / 30 FROM hockey.HOF WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1980 AND category = 'Player'

question: 哪个国家培养的冰球运动员最多？请标明哪一年出生的冰球运动员最多。
query: SELECT DISTINCT birthCountry, birthYear FROM hockey.Master GROUP BY birthCountry, birthYear ORDER BY COUNT(birthCountry) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 门将完封次数最多的球队，其胜场数是多少？
query: SELECT SUM(W) FROM hockey.Goalies GROUP BY tmID ORDER BY SUM(SHO) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 第9老的冰球运动员打什么位置？
query: SELECT pos FROM hockey.Master WHERE birthYear IS NOT NULL ORDER BY birthYear, birthMon, birthDay LIMIT 1 OFFSET 8

question: 1924年WCHL联盟，门将在场上的失球数是多少？请指出该联盟失球最多的门将。
query: SELECT SUM(PostGA) FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE lgID = 'WCHL' AND year = '1924' GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY SUM(PostGA) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2006年，十月输球最多的球队，其十月输球场次是多少？请标明球队ID。
query: SELECT OctL, tmID FROM hockey.TeamSplits WHERE year = '2006' ORDER BY OctL DESC LIMIT 1

question: 左右手均可射门/接球的球员中，有多少人在2011年首次亮相NHL？
query: SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM hockey.Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND firstNHL = '2011'

question: 哪一年球员进球总数最多？进球最多的那年他多大年纪？
query: SELECT T1.year, T1.year - T2.birthYear FROM hockey.Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.year, T1.year - T2.birthYear ORDER BY SUM(T1.G) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 70年代出生且左手射门/接球的门将平均身高是多少？其中最高的球员最近效力的球队是哪支？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.height) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) FROM hockey.AwardsPlayers AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.height IS NOT NULL AND (T2.pos = 'LW' OR T2.pos = 'L/C')

question: NHL历史上助攻最多的球员总助攻数是多少？请标明其全名。
query: SELECT SUM(T1.A), T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM hockey.Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.lgID = 'NHL' GROUP BY T2.firstName, T2.lastName ORDER BY SUM(T1.A) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 少防多次数最少的球队，其多打少成功率是多少？他们那场比赛的对手是谁？请标明球队是输还是赢。
query: SELECT SUM(T1.A), T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM hockey.Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.lgID = 'NHL' GROUP BY T2.firstName, T2.lastName ORDER BY SUM(T1.A) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 史上胜场最多的教练获得过哪些奖项？请标明教练ID。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.coachID, T1.award FROM hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID GROUP BY T2.coachID, T1.award ORDER BY SUM(T2.w) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1912年表演赛中输球的球队名称是什么？
query: SELECT T2.name FROM hockey.SeriesPost AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND tmIDLoser = tmID WHERE T1.note = 'EX' AND T2.year = '1912'

question: 2003年至2005年间，罚时在200至250分钟之间的球员中，比赛场次最多的球员名字是什么？
query: SELECT T2.nameGiven FROM hockey.Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID AND T1.PIM BETWEEN 200 AND 250 AND T1.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2005 ORDER BY T1.GP DESC LIMIT 1

question: NHL中失球最少的门将，退役时是多少岁？
query: SELECT T2.lastNHL - T2.birthYear FROM hockey.GoaliesSC AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lastNHL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T2.lastNHL, T2.birthYear ORDER BY SUM(GA) LIMIT 1

question: 获得奖项最多的位置是哪个？该位置最近获奖的球员是谁？请标明奖项名称和球员全名。
query: SELECT T1.pos, T2.award, T1.nameGiven, T1.lastName FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T2.coachID = T1.coachID GROUP BY T1.pos, T2.award, T1.nameGiven, T1.lastName ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) LIMIT 1

question: 获得首届全明星第二阵容奖项的教练，在获该奖之前打了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT SUM(T1.g) FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT coachID, year FROM hockey.AwardsCoaches WHERE award = 'Second Team All-Star' ORDER BY year LIMIT 1 ) AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID AND T1.year < T2.year

question: 在1915年取得最多胜利的球队对阵过多少支球队？请指出1915年获胜场次最多的球队名称，以及对手球队的名称。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oppID), T2.tmID, T2.oppID FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.TeamVsTeam AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID WHERE T2.year = 1915 GROUP BY T2.tmID, T2.oppID ORDER BY SUM(T2.W) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在少打多进球数在1到5之间的球队中，哪位球员在关键时刻最值得信赖？
query: SELECT T2.nameGiven, T2.lastName FROM hockey.Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.SHG BETWEEN 1 AND 5 ORDER BY T1.GWG DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1997年，临时执教坦帕湾闪电队的教练输了多少场比赛？请指明他/她的教练ID。
query: SELECT SUM(T1.l), T1.coachID FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.notes = 'interim' AND T1.year = '1997' AND T2.name = 'Tampa Bay Lightning' GROUP BY T1.coachID

question: 在少打多助攻数大于等于7的球员中，助攻总数最多的球队最终排名是多少？请指出取得最多助攻数的年份及球队名称。
query: SELECT T2.rank, T2.year, T2.name FROM hockey.Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.SHA >= 7 ORDER BY T1.A DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1969年带队获得第4名的教练叫什么名字？请指明他们的教练ID。
query: SELECT T1.coachID FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 1969 AND T2.rank = 4

question: 1917年至1920年间，每个赛季上半程排名第一的球队名称是什么？
query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM hockey.TeamsHalf AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.half = 1 AND T1.rank = 1 AND T1.year BETWEEN 1917 AND 1920

question: 首次加入NHL时年龄在18至24岁之间、累计进球总数不超过5个的加拿大球员有多少？请列出他们的全名、年份以及他们进球的球队。
query: SELECT T2.nameGiven, T2.lastName, T2.birthYear, birthMon, birthDay , T3.tmID FROM hockey.Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T2.playerID = T1.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T3.tmID = T1.tmID WHERE (T2.firstNHL - T2.birthYear) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 AND T3.G < 5

question: 圣路易斯蓝调队在所有比赛中总共被判了多少次队小罚？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(BenchMinor) AS REAL) / 2 FROM hockey.Teams WHERE name = 'St. Louis Blues'

question: 纽约游骑兵队在2009年的强打机会转化率是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(PPG AS REAL) / PPC FROM hockey.Teams WHERE year = 2009 AND name = 'New York Rangers'

question: 一支球队在单赛季获得的最高总积分是多少？
query: SELECT SUM(Pts), year FROM hockey.Teams GROUP BY year, tmID ORDER BY SUM(Pts) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在2006年胜场多于负场的球队中，有多少支积分超过100分？
query: SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM hockey.Teams WHERE year = 2006 AND W > L AND Pts > 100

question: 哪支球队在2006年获得了最多的队小罚？
query: SELECT name FROM hockey.Teams WHERE year = 2006 GROUP BY tmID, name ORDER BY CAST(SUM(BenchMinor) AS REAL) / 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: 请列出2006年被罚时间最长的前3支球队。
query: SELECT name FROM hockey.Teams WHERE year = 2006 GROUP BY tmID, name ORDER BY SUM(PIM) DESC LIMIT 3

question: 1995年，佛罗里达美洲豹队、埃德蒙顿油人队和洛杉矶国王队中，哪支球队的少防多机会最高？
query: SELECT name FROM hockey.Teams WHERE year = 1995 AND name IN ('Florida Panthers', 'Edmonton Oilers', 'Los Angeles Kings') ORDER BY PKC DESC LIMIT 1

question: 在1917年斯坦利杯决赛中，胜场多于负场的球队叫什么名字？
query: SELECT T2.name FROM hockey.TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = '1917' AND T1.W > T1.L

question: 请列出参加了1922年斯坦利杯决赛的球队。
query: SELECT T2.name FROM hockey.TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = '1922'

question: 在参加1922年斯坦利杯决赛的球队中，有多少支球队当年积分超过20分？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.tmID) FROM hockey.TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = '1922' AND T2.Pts > 20

question: 在1923年斯坦利杯决赛中，当年排名第二的球队的罚时是多少？
query: SELECT T1.PIM FROM hockey.TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = '1923' AND T2.rank = 2

question: 哪支球队在斯坦利杯决赛中获胜场次最多？
query: SELECT T2.name FROM hockey.TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year GROUP BY T2.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.W) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 1985年，费城飞人队对阵波士顿棕熊队赢了多少场比赛？
query: SELECT T1.W FROM hockey.TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 1985 AND T1.tmID = ( SELECT DISTINCT tmID FROM hockey.Teams WHERE name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' ) AND T1.oppID = ( SELECT DISTINCT tmID FROM hockey.Teams WHERE name = 'Boston Bruins' )

question: 请列出1909年打成平局的球队名称。
query: SELECT T2.name, T3.name FROM hockey.TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.oppID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.year = 1909 AND T1.T = 1

question: 请列出执教过蒙特利尔加拿大人队的教练的名字（名）。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.firstName FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

question: 蒙特利尔加拿大人队的教练中有多少人进入了名人堂？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hofID) FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

question: 请给出蒙特利尔加拿大人队最高教练的身高。
query: SELECT T3.height FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T3.coachID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T3.height DESC LIMIT 1

question: 请列出执教过参加1922年斯坦利杯决赛球队的教练的名字（名）。
query: SELECT T3.firstName FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.year = 1922

question: 在执教过费城飞人队的教练中，有多少人出生在三月？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.coachID) FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' AND T3.birthMon = 3

question: 在美国出生的教练中，有多少人曾经执教过费城飞人队？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.coachID) FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' AND T3.birthCountry = 'USA'

question: 执教过水牛城军刀队的教练中有多少人已去世？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.coachID) FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T3.deathYear IS NOT NULL

question: 请列出美国出生并执教过水牛城军刀队的教练的昵称。
query: SELECT DISTINCT nameNick FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' AND T3.birthCountry = 'USA'

question: 在执教过参加1922年斯坦利杯决赛球队的教练中，有多少人来自美国？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.coachID) FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year AND T1.tmID = T2.tmID INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.year = 1922 AND T3.birthCountry = 'USA'

question: 2000年，哪支球队与水牛城军刀队比赛场次最多？

question: 蒙特利尔加拿大人队在1918年斯坦利杯决赛中有多少罚时？

question: 在蒙特利尔加拿大人队斯坦利杯决赛罚时为24分钟的那一年，该队总共赢了多少场比赛？

question: 哪位教练是第一个执教蒙特利尔加拿大人队的，请给出他的名字（名）。

question: 水牛城军刀队在2000年的平均胜率是多少？

question: 蒙特利尔加拿大人队在斯坦利杯决赛中的平均罚时是多少？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.PIM) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.PIM) FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

question: 蒙特利尔加拿大人队在斯坦利杯决赛中的平均胜率是多少？
query: SELECT SUM(T2.W / T2.G) / SUM(T2.G + T2.W) FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

question: 在执教过蒙特利尔加拿大人队的教练中，美国教练占百分之几？
query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T3.coachID) * 100 FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

question: 谁是最矮的球员？请列出该球员在1925年至1936年间效力的球队ID。
query: SELECT T2.playerID, T2.tmID FROM ( SELECT playerID FROM hockey.Master WHERE height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY height ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT playerID, tmID FROM hockey.Scoring WHERE year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 ) AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID

question: 哪支球队在2000年拥有最高的胜率？请列出该球队ID及其球员的出生国家。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T3.tmID, T1.birthCountry FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN ( SELECT year, tmID FROM hockey.Teams WHERE year = 2000 ORDER BY W / (W + L) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID AND T2.year = T3.year

question: 1998年，'CAR'队场均胜场数是多少？哪位球员贡献了最多的进球？请列出其球员ID。
query: SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL) / T1.G, T2.playerID FROM hockey.Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Scoring AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.tmID = 'CAR' AND T1.year = 1998 GROUP BY T1.W / T1.G, T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.G) DESC LIMIT 1

query: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T4.calories > 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM cookbook.Recipe AS T1 INNER JOIN cookbook.Quantity AS T2 ON T1.recipe_id = T2.recipe_id INNER JOIN cookbook.Ingredient AS T3 ON T3.ingredient_id = T2.ingredient_id INNER JOIN cookbook.Nutrition AS T4 ON T4.recipe_id = T1.recipe_id WHERE T3.category = 'cheese'

question: 哪次行程的持续时间最长？请说明起始站和终点站。
query: SELECT start_station_name, end_station_name FROM bike_share_1.trip WHERE duration = ( SELECT MAX(duration) FROM bike_share_1.trip )

question: 由订阅者完成的行程占百分之几？

question: 说明13号自行车的最终站点。它在哪个城市？

question: 列出所有借出和归还日期不同的行程。说明自行车归还时的城市。

question: 在2013/11/03 02:01:01时，哪个站点没有自行车可借？说明该站点的位置。

question: 行程ID 4080当天的最热温度是多少？

question: 在2013年8月的行程中，有多少自行车是从Redwood City借出的？

question: 普通用户借出自行车最少的站点是什么？说明该站点的安装日期。

question: 哪条路线的持续时间最长？说明站点所在的城市。

question: 从Adobe on Almaden站点到Ryland Park的行程的平均持续时间是多少？

question: 列出起始站点和终点站点相同的行程。给出它们的行程ID和位置坐标。

question: 在订阅者中，有多少人分别以2nd at Folsom和Civic Center BART (7th at Market)作为起点站和终点站，在最低能见度4英里的条件下，用时不超过490秒完成了行程？

question: 行程ID为912900的起点站有多少个可用的停车桩？

question: 2014年，订阅者从2nd at Folsom出发到5th at Howard结束的行程中最短持续时间是多少？比平均值短多少？给出该行程的最低温度、最大阵风速度和天气事件。

question: 2015年5月平均湿度在65到75之间时，平均最高温度和平均最低温度是多少？

question: 计算2013年6月出行的普通用户数量和订阅者数量之间的差值。

question: 对于2013年8月从Market at 10th站出发到South Van Ness at Market站结束的行程，哪一天的温度最低？

question: 计算降雨量超过0.8英寸的雨天中，骑行的平均持续时间。

question: 在Mary Smith租借电影的次数中，有多少次发生在2005年6月？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.customer_id) FROM movie_3.payment AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_3.customer AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T2.first_name = 'MARY' AND T2.last_name = 'SMITH' AND STRFTIME('%Y',T1.payment_date) = '2005' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.payment_date) = '6'

question: 请给出单次电影租借支付最高金额的客户的全名。
query: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name FROM movie_3.payment AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_3.customer AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id ORDER BY T1.amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: 意大利的客户在电影租借上总共花了多少钱？
query: SELECT SUM(T5.amount) FROM movie_3.address AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_3.city AS T2 ON T1.city_id = T2.city_id INNER JOIN movie_3.country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.country_id INNER JOIN movie_3.customer AS T4 ON T1.address_id = T4.address_id INNER JOIN movie_3.payment AS T5 ON T4.customer_id = T5.customer_id WHERE T3.country = 'Italy'

question: 在Mary Smith的支付中，有多少笔超过4.99？
query: SELECT COUNT(T1.amount) FROM movie_3.payment AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_3.customer AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T2.first_name = 'MARY' AND T2.last_name = 'SMITH' AND T1.amount > 4.99

question: 意大利客户在单次电影租借上平均花费多少钱？
query: SELECT AVG(T5.amount) FROM movie_3.address AS T1 INNER JOIN movie_3.city AS T2 ON T1.city_id = T2.city_id INNER JOIN movie_3.country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.country_id INNER JOIN movie_3.customer AS T4 ON T1.address_id = T4.address_id INNER JOIN movie_3.payment AS T5 ON T4.customer_id = T5.customer_id WHERE T3.country = 'Italy'
